What's Shenmue - @COMMIT@
-------------------------------------------

This release reimplements the original What's Shenmue promotional demo for PC.


To install, copy WhatsShenmue.exe into your What's Shenmue data directory, alongside its sprite subdirectory containing TNTITLE.SPR.

Launch WhatsShenmue.exe from that directory, or drag your What's Shenmue data directory onto it.
